description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Reckless Barbarian.
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Koll triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.
